criteria.requirement: Add webcolors.css_rgb.parse_css_rgb and serialize_css_rgb, using RGBA byte semantics from the prior goal. Support legacy rgb(r,g,b)/rgba(r,g,b,a) with all-number or all-percent channels and modern rgb()/rgba() three whitespace-separated channels with optional / alpha. Modern channels may mix numeric and percent; numeric exponent syntax is allowed if finite. Clamp RGB/alpha to their range then round to nearest byte with halves up. Reject mixed separators, partial suffixes, missing components, NaN/Inf, none, calc/var and unsupported expressions. Serializer uses stable modern syntax and roundtrips every alpha byte without loss. Keep existing name/hex/HTML parsers untouched and document the deliberately supported subset.
